zh.title: 達美航空將於2027年3月開辦西雅圖至東京成田直飛航線
zh.summary: 達美航空預計2027年3月27日開辦西雅圖至東京成田每日直飛航線。
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）宣布將於2027年3月27日開辦西雅圖-塔科馬國際機場（SEA）至東京成田國際機場（NRT）的每日直飛航線。該航線將採用空中巴士（Airbus）A330-900neo機型執飛，與達美航空現有的西雅圖至東京羽田國際機場（HND）直飛航班並行營運。
達美航空國際網路規劃副總裁Jeff Arinder表示，新增成田航線可為旅客提供更多彈性與東京航點選擇。西雅圖港務局委員Toshiko Hasegawa則指出，擴展雙機場服務將進一步鞏固兩地經貿與文化交流。達美航空目前在西雅圖每日尖峰營運超過160個出發航班。

en.title: Delta Air Lines to Launch Nonstop Seattle-Tokyo Narita Route in March 2027
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will launch daily nonstop Seattle-Tokyo Narita flights using Airbus A330-900neo aircraft starting March 2027.
body: Delta Air Lines announced it will launch daily nonstop service between Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) and Tokyo-Narita International Airport (NRT) on March 27, 2027. The route will be operated using Airbus A330-900neo aircraft, supplementing the carrier's existing daily flights between Seattle and Tokyo-Haneda International Airport (HND).

Jeff Arinder, Delta's Vice President of International Network Planning, stated that adding Narita service expands capacity and passenger choices for travel to Japan. Port of Seattle Commissioner Toshiko Hasegawa added that expanded access to both Tokyo airports strengthens regional economic and cultural ties. Delta currently operates over 160 peak-day departures from Seattle.
